Every CV choice of the comparator suite and its place in its grid. `interior`: neither end; `range end`: the end of the parameter's range (common.DOMAIN_ENDS; for the EBM also classification.range_ends: all feature pairs, or more bins than any feature has values), where the grid cannot be widened; `tie`: at a grid end, but a combination of the stage's grid with an interior value of the parameter has exactly the same CV score, so the optimum is not at the edge (search.interior_tie); `re-tuned`: a later stage tunes the parameter again and decides its final value; `EDGE`: at an end of the grid that could be widened.
